svg.text: A rough sketch of the module hierarchy in Kvazaar.
Arrows mean that a module uses another. Only the important
relationships are shown, to keep the hierarchy readable.
Used by the search, reconstruction, SAO, lookahead and bitstream coding modules.
Implementations in strategies/generic, sse2, sse41, avx2, neon and altivec; the strategyselector picks the fastest one the CPU supports at startup.
